title: Product Manager (12 month FTC)
description: Product Manager, Ordnance Survey (Britain's national mapping agency, public body). Full time 12 month Fixed Term Contract. £57,148 - £66,674. Hybrid, Southampton HQ, 50% of working week in office. Own a portfolio of street-related products for the Transport market: product strategy and propositions from customer insight; outcome-based roadmaps; review performance with scorecards, KPIs and customer outcomes; product leadership in cross-functional delivery teams; user engagement and research; engage customers, partners and external stakeholders; communicate strategy and roadmap decisions to senior stakeholders. Experience managing product performance and roadmaps in a customer-focused environment, data-driven decisions, stakeholder engagement. Desirable: street-related products, highways asset management, transport sector. Tools: Aha!, QGIS, ArcGIS, PowerBI, Co-Pilot. Right to work in UK required, no sponsorship. DBS check. Closing 29 November 2026.
